description_en:
Queries quality rule tasks by paging.
Online version: v5.4.2
description_zh:
分页查询质量规则任务。
上线版本：v5.4.2
name: ListQualityRuleTasks

fields.help_en: The ID of the quality watchtask
fields.name: watch_task_id

fields.help_en:
The rule type. Valid values:
CONSISTENT: consistency
EFFECTIVE: validity
TIMELINESE: timeliness
ACCURATE: accuracy
UNIQUENESS: uniqueness
COMPLETENESS: completeness
STABILITY: stability
CUSTOM: custom
fields.help_zh: 规则类型: CONSISTENT 一致性，EFFECTIVE 有效性，TIMELINESE 时效性，ACCURATE 准确性，UNIQUENESS 唯一性，COMPLETENESS 完整性，STABILITY 稳定性，CUSTOM 自定义
fields.name: catalog_list

fields.help_en:
The rule strength. Valid values:
STRONG: strong
WEAK: weak
fields.help_zh: 规则强度: STRONG 强、WEAK 弱
fields.name: rule_strength_list

fields.help_en:
The task status. Valid values:
NOT_RUN: not executed
WAITING: waiting
RUNNING: running
SUCCESS: succeeded
FAILED: failed
CANCEL: canceled
TIMEOUT: timed out
OFFLINE: offline
fields.help_zh: 任务状态: NOT_RUN 未执行、WAITING 等待中、RUNNING 执行中、SUCCESS 执行成功、FAILED 执行失败、CANCEL 取消、TIMEOUT 超时、OFFLINE 离线
fields.name: status_list

fields.help_en:
The validation result. Valid values:
NOT_RUN: not executed
WAITING: waiting for execution
RUNNING: running
PASS: passed
NOT_PASS: not passed
FAILED: execution failed
OFFLINE: offline and needs to be restarted
CANCEL: task canceled
TIMEOUT: task timed out
fields.help_zh: 校验结果: NOT_RUN 未执行、WAITING 等待执行、RUNNING 执行中、PASS 通过、NOT_PASS 不通过、FAILED 执行失败、OFFLINE 掉线,需要重新拉起、CANCEL 任务取消、TIMEOUT 任务超时
fields.name: validate_result_list

fields.help_en:
The rule label. Valid values:
DEFAULT: default label
DATA_STANDARD_MANUAL: standard rule manually created
DATA_STANDARD_AUTO: quality rule created by automatic creation from a standard
PIPELINE: rule created by a pipeline
DATA_MODELING: data modeling diagnostics
fields.help_zh: 规则标签: DEFAULT 默认标签、DATA_STANDARD_MANUAL 手工创建的标准规则、、DATA_STANDARD_AUTO 标准自动创建的质量规则、PIPELINE PIPELINE创建的规则、DATA_MODELING 数据建模
fields.name: rule_tag_list

fields.help_en: The search keyword. You can search by field name or rule name
fields.help_zh: 搜索词，字段名或者规则名搜索
fields.name: keyword

fields.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20
fields.name: page_size
